import pandas as pd

# Analyze yellowtail catches by class and season to find streak patterns
trips = tables['trips']

# Group by class and fishing date, sum catches and count anglers
daily_by_class = trips.groupby(['cls', 'fish_date_t', 'fish_date_season', 'fish_date_doy']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

# Calculate by-class daily totals
daily_summary = trips.groupby(['fish_date_t', 'fish_date_season', 'fish_date_doy']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
daily_summary['avg_per_angler'] = daily_summary['yt'] / daily_summary['anglers']
daily_summary = daily_summary.sort_values('fish_date_t')

# Show recent days (last 30 days)
print("Last 30 days of yellowtail catches:")
print(daily_summary.tail(30)[['fish_date_season', 'fish_date_doy', 'yt', 'anglers', 'avg_per_angler']])

print("\n\nYellowtail by class (all time):")
class_summary = trips.groupby('cls').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).reset_index()
class_summary['avg_per_angler'] = class_summary['yt'] / class_summary['anglers']
class_summary = class_summary.sort_values('avg_per_angler', ascending=False)
print(class_summary)

# Analyze seasonal patterns - when yellowtail show up
trips = tables['trips']

# Group by day of year, sum all catches
doy_summary = trips.groupby(['fish_date_doy']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
doy_summary['avg_per_angler'] = doy_summary['yt'] / doy_summary['anglers']
doy_summary = doy_summary.sort_values('fish_date_doy')

# Show doy 1-200 (spring through summer)
print("Yellowtail by day of year (spring/summer):")
print(doy_summary[doy_summary['fish_date_doy'] <= 200][['fish_date_doy', 'yt', 'avg_per_angler']])

print("\n\nTotal yellowtail by month (approximation):")
doy_summary['month'] = (doy_summary['fish_date_doy'] - 1) // 30 + 1
monthly = doy_summary.groupby('month').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).reset_index()
monthly['avg_per_angler'] = monthly['yt'] / monthly['anglers']
print(monthly)

# Find consecutive days with catches (streaks)
print("\n\nLooking for streaks (consecutive days with yt > 0):")
